edges.reason: msg.sender is checked by the onlyOwner modifier before initiateSale can flip saleInitiated.
msg.sender is checked by the onlyOwner modifier guarding setBaseURI.
msg.sender is compared to lcdContract by the onlyLCD modifier on mintWithLoot.
msg.sender is hashed into the seed feeding the weak pseudo-random generator.
block.timestamp is both summed into and used as divisor of the randomness seed (timestamp dependency).
_assignProperties is the function that executes the block-based pseudo-random seed computation.
The seed is divided by 1e36 and the result written into tokenIdToPropString.
mintWithLoot calls _safeMint, which performs the external onERC721Received callback before _assignProperties.
mintWithoutLoot calls _safeMint, triggering the external onERC721Received callback.
mintAsCurator calls _safeMint, triggering the external onERC721Received callback.
mintWithLoot invokes _assignProperties after minting the token.
tokenURI performs the external getCustomTokenURI call on the configured LCD contract.
tokenURI calls getImageProp to fill parts[1].
tokenURI calls getPosterizeProp to fill parts[5].
getProps aggregates getImageProp into its output string.
getProps aggregates getColorProp into its output string.
getImageProp reads its propString from the tokenIdToPropString mapping.
getPosterizeProp reads lootContract and calls getFoot on it.
The reentrant onERC721Received callback executes before tokenIdToPropString is written, exposing uninitialized prop state.
minter parameter is forwarded into _safeMint inside mintWithLoot.
tokenId parameter is used by _safeMint and _assignProperties in mintWithLoot.
tokenId parameter drives all prop lookups and the LCD custom URI query in tokenURI.
_tokenId parameter is hashed into the seed and used as the storage key in _assignProperties.
baseURI parameter is passed into _setBaseURI by setBaseURI.
Local propString captures the output of the pseudo-random seed computation.
Local effectiveTokenId (tokenId.sub(4245)) drives the loot lookup in getPosterizeProp.
Local propString drives the modulo branch selection in getImageProp.
Local parts array accumulates the SVG fragments later encoded in tokenURI.
Local customURI holds the return value of the external LCD getCustomTokenURI call.
Local where string is padded and scanned inside contains.
Local temp iterates and is divided by ten inside toString.

normalization_plan.reason: minter is only an argument of mintWithLoot and carries no independent semantics.
tokenId is consumed entirely by mintWithLoot/_safeMint and _assignProperties.
tokenId is solely the lookup key used by tokenURI.
_tokenId exists only to key the seed and tokenIdToPropString write.
baseURI is immediately forwarded to _setBaseURI by setBaseURI.
propString is the intermediate value of the weak pseudo-random computation.
effectiveTokenId is a temporary derived only for the posterize loot lookup.
propString in getImageProp is a transient copy of tokenIdToPropString.
parts is a temporary string array used solely inside tokenURI.
customURI is the transient holder of the external LCD call result.
where is a locally mutated copy of the input string inside contains.
temp is a scratch counter used only within the toString loop.
